buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 3. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Supply: The successful bidder shall supply, install, test and commission the Data Wall, in cluding all necessary accessories, cables, mounting structures, controllers and software required for satisfactory operation. 2. Technical Specifications: The Data Wall shall conform to the specifications mentioned in the GeM bid. The size of 320 × 160 shall be as specified in the bid document. The bidder must clearly mentio n the product make, model, technical specifications and country of origin. 3. Installation and Commissioning: Installation, configuration, testing and commissioning at the co

nsignee's site shall be the responsibility of the successful bidder. All associated charges shall be incl uded in the quoted price unless otherwise specified in the bid. 4. Warranty: The supplied equipment shall carry a minimum warranty of three (3) years from the dat e of successful installation and commissioning, subject to the final GeM bid conditions. 5. After-Sales Service: The bidder shall provide technical support and maintenance during the warra nty period. Complaints shall be attended to within 48 hours of notification, with resolution within a r easonable period. 6. Delivery Period: The supply, installation and commissioning shall be completed within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract. 7. Inspection and Acceptance: The equipment shall be inspected and tested by the consignee or an authorized committee. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory performance and complianc e with the prescribed technical specifications. 9. Documents to be Supplied: The bidder shall provide the user manual, warranty certificate, techni cal datasheet, installation report and any applicable statutory compliance certificates. 10. Training: The successful bidder shall provide basic operational and maintenance training to the des ignated personnel at no additional cost. 11. Genuine Products: The supplied equipment shall be new, unused and free from manufacturing de fects. Refurbished or second-hand equipment shall not be accepted. 12. Compliance with GeM Conditions: All terms and conditions of the GeM bid, General Terms and C onditions, applicable procurement rules and the resulting contract shall remain binding. In case of a ny inconsistency, the applicable GeM and statutory provisions shall prevail. 13. Liquidated Damages: Delay in delivery or commissioning shall attract liquidated damages, if appli cable, in accordance with the GeM contract conditions. 14. Right to Reject: The purchaser reserves the right to reject equipment that does not conform to the approved specifications or fails acceptance testing, in accordance with the contract terms. 15. Safety and Electrical Requirements: The system shall comply with applicable electrical safety st andards and shall be supplied with the necessary power and signal cables, earthing provisions and protective accessories required for safe operation. Module Size: The offred LED display module shall of 320x160 mm Size Pixel Pitch -2.5mm Pixel Density-16000 pixels /m2 Pixel Density-1R1G1B LED Packege-SMD2020 Warranty - 02 Years .
